conv2d.describe:
target gpu       : Apple M4 Max (Apple9 GPU family)
kernel name      : conv2d_kernel
threadgroups     : grid = (2, 1458, 1)  (2916 threadgroups; used when the source has no taic-launch block)
threads / group  : (128, 1, 1)  (128 threads = 4 SIMD groups of 32; used when the source has no taic-launch block)
compile-time constants (already defined in the header):
  constant constexpr uint N = 32
  constant constexpr uint H = 56
  constant constexpr uint W = 56
  constant constexpr uint C = 64
  constant constexpr uint OC = 128
  constant constexpr uint KH = 3
  constant constexpr uint KW = 3
  constant constexpr uint OH = 54
  constant constexpr uint OW = 54
  constant constexpr uint M_TOTAL = 93312
  constant constexpr uint K_TOTAL = 576
  constant constexpr uint BLOCK_M = 64
  constant constexpr uint BLOCK_N = 64
  constant constexpr uint BLOCK_K = 32
buffer / scalar arguments (index, name and access are fixed):
  [[buffer(0)]] input  fp16  x shape=[32, 56, 56, 64]  NHWC
  [[buffer(1)]] input  fp16  w shape=[128, 3, 3, 64]  [OC, KH, KW, C]
  [[buffer(2)]] output fp16  y shape=[32, 54, 54, 128]  NHWC, stride 1, no padding, no bias
